system.description: A progressive development of Baal's Caress, this power coats an edged weapon with a blood-based poison so potent it corrodes the very weapon that bears it. You coat a bladed weapon with your own blood, spend one or more Blood Traits, and make a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of 7 Traits (retest Willpower). The weapon now does aggravated damage and gains a number of Envenomed Traits equal to the Blood Traits spent, added to its bonus Traits. On a successful strike, make a Simple Test for each Envenomed Trait the weapon currently has; success inflicts an additional health level of damage. At the end of each turn the weapon loses one Envenomed Trait; when the last is lost, the weapon is destroyed by the corrosive venom.
